stop_rule: Exactly four back/left standing-fall development cases at 250/125 microseconds. No pause-duration, torque, gain or capture-threshold sweep. All four must pass and be audited before broader regression; preserve failures and diagnose rather than repeat.

report.name: back-250us
report.scope: A single fixed pause in the back prefix, ending on unchanged capture gates or a 0.5 s timeout. Four motors, 120 mm wheels, original success/electrical/mechanism guards and at most one controller retry. Continuous standing fall and recovery; no state reset, new weights or hardware qualification.
